title: Defer long Settings collection rows
goal: Avoid eagerly constructing every row in the Settings model library, imported-file list, and workspace search/directory results while preserving existing actions and order.
context: SettingsScreen is hosted in the scrollable ScreenScaffold, but four potentially long collections are direct children of GlassPanel's eager VStack: installed models, imported files, workspace search results, and visible workspace entries. This creates every row when the panel is rendered rather than when it approaches the viewport.
forbidden_changes: Do not change data loading, ordering, filtering, persistence, authorization, or destructive-action confirmation.
Do not change Provider model selection Picker behavior or nested scroll behavior.
Do not modify other screens, Kernel, Runtime, or Xcode project files.
Do not claim measured device performance gains without physical-device profiling.
acceptance_criteria: The installed-model rows use a LazyVStack while preserving select/delete behavior and row order.
The imported-file rows use a LazyVStack while preserving preview/delete behavior and row order.
Workspace search-result and directory-entry rows use LazyVStack while preserving navigation/open behavior and row order.
Empty/loading states and surrounding Settings content remain unchanged.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head; physical-device performance remains unmeasured without device evidence.
verification: Review all four list branches and their unchanged actions/order.
Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Revert the single logical task commit if row interaction or native build regresses; retain existing eager behavior only for a collection that cannot safely use a lazy container.
